target_customer: Bloggers, publishers and communities that wanted their own branded, Reddit style social news site without building the software
problem: Anyone who wanted a voting based news site for their community had to run open source software or build one; Slinkset offered a hosted, white label version that could also be embedded in an existing site.
business_model: Hosted white label platform, free at launch with a fixed fee planned later and ad placement planned

founders.name: Brett Gibson
prior_employers: Y Combinator (wrote software, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as founder of Posterous, Posthaven and Slinkset and now managing partner at Initialized Capital. TechCrunch July 2008 names him as co-founder.

founders.name: John Baunach
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page with no bio.

competitors.name: Reddit
competitors.what: Social news site that let users create their own hosted subreddits with limited customization

competitors.name: Mixx
competitors.what: Social news site that offered a similar hosted option

technical_complexity.rationale: A voting and ranking site with theming and embedding is standard web engineering for a two person team; the hard parts were multi tenant hosting and spam control.

defensibility.rationale: Open source clones such as Pligg existed and Reddit itself offered hosted communities, so copying the feature set was easy and each customer site owned its own audience.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent bought it. A fellow YC company, Posterous, acquired it in June 2009 and said it would fold the technology into its own product.

market_need_then: Reddit had just been open sourced and hosted social news was a visible trend in 2008, but the sources show no customer count or revenue, so demand is only inferred from press interest.

branding.domain_note: Used slinkset.com; the domain now redirects to a GoDaddy for sale page (checked 2026).
branding.community_and_virality: A Hacker News launch post by Brett Gibson in March 2008 drew about 50 points; no evidence of merch or fan community.

brand_strength.rationale: No sources show brand assets, press about the brand itself or a user community; the white label product put customer brands first.

outcome_analysis: Slinkset launched a hosted white label social news product in spring and summer 2008 with two founders and no reported traction figures. In June 2009 Posterous, another YC company co-founded by Brett Gibson, acquired it on undisclosed terms, Gibson joined Posterous full time and Slinkset was meant to keep operating while its technology merged into Posterous. The YC directory lists it as inactive, so it ended as a soft landing for the team rather than a standalone business.
notes: YC status is Inactive while the exit is an acquisition by Posterous in June 2009; the site was said to continue operating afterward. The 20,000 dollar seed figure rests on a single directory listing (and a failure analysis site that repeats it) and no investor is named; it is probably the standard YC deal but no source says so. CB Insights returned 403 so its Slinkset page was not read; a search summary attributed an August 2014 acquisition date to it, which conflicts with the 2009 press and is ignored. Slinkset.com is now parked for sale.
